answer: A sybil tax blocks fake identities. Each agent pays a non-refundable 50-credit tax for one identity; the receipt cannot be transferred. It must tend one orchard row for a season. A verifier checks its trellis upkeep before paid work. It also files one original sonnet as a work sample. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 credits, sunk regardless, so flooding loses money. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
